messages:
Mina (Finance): AP hold on CloudLine invoice 2026-CL-489 — bot says 'PO not matched' and rate differs from our SOW. Can AP confirm what fields are missing? :mag:

Sam (Accounts Payable): AP bot flagged missing PO and unit price mismatch. We have PO 4120 for CloudLine at $0.075/hr from a one-off purchase. Invoice shows $0.09/hr. Need either a PO that references $0.09 or a signed amendment.

Irene (Vendor Ops): Pinged CloudLine. They claim they switched to new pricing tier (v2) in Feb; they attached an 'email confirmation' but no executed amendment. They offered to accept our old rate if we ask.

Mina (Finance): If vendor will accept old rate, have them reissue invoice referencing PO 4120. If they insist on $0.09, we need a signed amendment with effective date and explicit rate language.

billing-bot: Invoice 2026-CL-489 uploaded by Irene; status changed to HOLD: PO_MISMATCH.

Sam (Accounts Payable): To speed routing, amendment template needs exact phrasing: "Effective 2026-02-01, Section 2.1 of SOW #SL-2025 is amended to set GPU rate to $0.09/hr." Also require vendor signature + Redwood signature line.

Irene (Vendor Ops): Noted. I've asked CloudLine for either (A) reissued invoice referencing PO 4120 at $0.075/hr or (B) signed amendment using that language. Requested response by 17:00 PT.

Javier (Legal): If they want retroactive higher billing without signed amendment, we shouldn't accept it. If they provide an email thread with mutual assent + accounting practice evidence, we can consider, but written amendment is preferred for audit.

Sam (Accounts Payable): FYI if we accept retroactive rate without amendment it complicates PO accounting and might require a manual non-PO invoice process and VP sign-off.

Mina (Finance): Thanks. If vendor doesn't respond, I'll escalate to Procurement lead tomorrow. Please keep AP ticket updated — ticket #AP-7784.

Irene (Vendor Ops): CloudLine replied — they can reissue under PO 4120 but only if we sign a short amendment agreeing to backdate the change. Asking if we can auto-sign a standard amendment.

Javier (Legal): We won't auto-sign a backdated amendment. Ask vendor to issue invoice at the agreed PO rate OR propose an amendment effective going forward, not retroactive.

Irene (Vendor Ops): Got it. Told them no backdating. They said they'll reissue at the old rate for this invoice and open a separate change request for future billing. Sending new PDF now.

billing-bot: New invoice 2026-CL-489v2 uploaded and matched to PO 4120 by Irene — awaiting AP final review.

Sam (Accounts Payable): Verified match, applied early-pay discount per PO terms, routing for payment. Closing hold. :white_check_mark:

Mina (Finance): Great — thanks everyone. Marking as resolved.

Irene (Vendor Ops): Closing loop with vendor and asked them to submit amendment if they change pricing going forward.

Mina (Finance): Added note to vendor master: require signed amendment for pricing tier changes.
